_meta.usage: type only the region code: the two or three digits on the right of the plate, above RUS and the flag (А 123 ВС 77 → 77, А 123 ВС 799 → 799)
_meta.note: The code is where the vehicle was registered, not where the photo was taken. A three-digit code that is not in the table falls back to its first two digits, which are usually another region: the lookup marks such a match with "only '..' matched"; treat it as a miss. Some codes have an earlier owner (an autonomous okrug merged into a krai or oblast) or were issued in other regions for a time; those keys list every place.
_meta.miss_note: not a Russian region code: misread digits, a whole plate (type only the digits on the right), a yellow or black plate of another country, a military plate (black, code = military district), a diplomatic plate (red), or a code issued after this table was fetched
